note: Black tint at alpha 0xCC, about the terminal's opacity 80. Needs translucent-windows.patch (applied in Windhawk's editor and compiled): the stock mod blurs the backdrop, the patch makes it a flat see-through tint like the terminal. In Advanced, set Custom process inclusion list to explorer.exe AND tick
(Include/exclude custom only); otherwise the mod still injects into every process, e.g. Flow Launcher.
